description: Recovered fx2-cmix GCC build with FX2_META_STREAK=2. Preserves the baseline final zero-context mixer and adds a weak first-layer meta-streak expert keyed by recent predictor correctness, streak bucket, bit context, line-break state, and longest match bucket.

build.packaging: cmix and english.dic are xz-packed and unpacked by program.py; both count toward the local driver program_size.

notes: Designed after FX2_META_STREAK=1 lost on the 1 MiB ledger by replacing the final-layer global mixer context.
This candidate keeps the baseline final-layer context and tests whether a weak additive streak expert can learn without destabilizing calibration.
verdict: Tiny 1 MiB ledger win only because the packed program is smaller; archive bytes regressed by 4. Keep as a reproducible package-size curiosity, not as a route toward the 10 percent target.
